newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Jan-Nov 96 real wages drop 3.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Jan-Nov 96 real wages drop 3.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Monthly average real wages of Hungary's industrial, retail and service sectors fell 3.6 percent in the January-November period of 1996 year-on-year, compared with a 3.9 percent drop in the first 10 months of the year, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Friday.

The average net monthly wage in the January-November period for non-agricultural enterprises was 31,040 forints, compared with 30,950 forints in January-October -- 19.5 percent more in nominal terms than in the same period of 1995.
Average inflation for the whole of 1996 is expected to be between 23 and 24 percent

Wage increases in the first eleven months of 1996 in the services sector were above average while the processing and construction industries, wood and paper production and printing lagged behind other sectors.
KSH figures are based on data from enterprises with more than 10 employees.
